Demonstrated two ways: (a) compute_delay_s-sized unknown time hidden inside a claimed phase (tx window inflated by cd with rate-consistent capacity, or an inflated declared propagation delay) passes chain2 with zero gaps, zero violations, zero closure errors and a green two-sided comparator (probe P1); the cheap physical invariant that would catch the tx case - for outcome=ok, (end-start)*rate_bps==served_bits, which holds by construction at kernel.py:2461/2576-2581 - is not checked anywhere in metrics_independent.py:297-363 nor asserted in the selftest; (b) a mechanism-inert run (zero gaps, all decision rows t==t_decision_start) yields admissible=true, all_agree=true, deferred=0 (probe P3a), because deferral is inferred from t>t_decision_start (step5_recompute.py:496-501) and no document or exit code requires gap_count_total>0 / deferred_decision_rows>0 in a cd05 cell; analyze and witness always exit 0 with no aggregate verdict field (step5_recompute.py:397-449, 452-576) and PROCEDURE.md sections 4-5 define no acceptance formula over the report fields.

ATTACK P1 (executed against the harness in memory): a delivered packet whose isl tx window is inflated by exactly cd (capacity kept rate-consistent, served=bits, outcome=ok) yields chain2 gap_count_total=0, gap_length_violation_total=0, closure_error_total=0, residual_s=0.0 - i.e. unknown simulated time equal to compute_delay_s hidden inside a claimed phase passes every chain-2 check with ZERO gaps, while the honest control yields one gap of exactly cd. The two-sided comparator is green in both cases because it reads the same ledger. The tell is checkable and missed: for outcome=ok the kernel always satisfies (end-start)*rate_bps==served_bits by construction (kernel.py:2461 dur=pkt.bits/rate; window end recorded at completion 2576-2581), but metrics_independent.py:297-363 validates capacity==rate*(end-start) and served==bits without ever validating the duration itself; an inflated declared propagation delay_s is likewise only checked against its own realized arrival (metrics_independent.py:242-255), with no external bound.

ATTACK P3a (executed, files in a platform temp dir): witness on bit-identical formal/diagnostic ledgers of a mechanism-inert run (delivered packet, zero gaps) with decision rows all having t==t_decision_start under --cd 0.05 returns admissible=true, deferred_decision_rows=0, immediate_decision_rows=2, delivered_gap_reconciliation_all_agree=true. Deferral is inferred from t>t_decision_start (step5_recompute.py:496-501), which is the very property under test, and nothing anywhere (brief acceptance, PROCEDURE.md sections 4-5, run-manifest acceptance, analyze/witness exit codes) requires gap_count_total>0 or deferred_decision_rows>0; analyze/witness always exit 0 with no aggregate verdict field (397-449, 452-576). So a fully green batch is compatible with the deferred-decision mechanism never engaging - the gate evidence cannot distinguish 'mechanism engaged and consumed exactly cd' from 'no unclaimed time existed'.

ATTACK P3b (executed): passing --formal-trace-sha256 X --diagnostic-trace-sha256 X flips witness admissible from false to true although the supplied receipts carry different trace hashes (TRUTH-FORMAL-1 vs TRUTH-DIAG-2); the explicit CLI values override the receipts via trace_of (step5_recompute.py:471-485, argparse 596-598). The three ledger digest checks stay file-bound, so this circumvents one of the four fail-loud identity checks - the exact rule the WP acceptance (brief.json acceptance item 5, PROCEDURE.md section 5) relies on.

ATTACK P2 (executed): an undelivered packet with 9 s of uncovered time after its only service window produces gap_length_violation_total=0 and a truncation bucket that reports sums and span ends but NO uncovered time at all - unknown simulated time on undelivered packets is invisible to chain 2 and unreported even as 'unverified'. In the corridor, which legitimately drops most load (ACCESS_QUEUE_OVERFLOW per brief), this can leave only a small, unstated fraction of deferred decisions covered by the cd check; disclosure exists only as the truncation_rule text and the witness's undelivered_decision_rows.

REFUTED attacks (credit where the harness holds): a production reading with all comparable fields renamed still produces mismatch_total=2 because the utilization branch flags production None vs independent value (probes P4b/P4c), so the comparator is not vacuous under schema drift; CONTIGUITY_EPS_S=1e-12 merging is bounded (probe P5: a 1e-13 s hole merges, negligible versus cd=0.05 and consistent with the declared 1e-9 tolerance contract); capacity tampering, overlapping availability windows and tampered production utilization are rejected (selftest 4-5); honest receipts with differing traces keep admissible=false (P3a baseline); R02 contains no gate-closure or lost-data-restoration language (grep; brief.json cannot_claim items 1 and 5; PROCEDURE.md:160-166 denies restoration).

Chain-1 completeness context: kernel.py:1878-1899 tiles availability over the whole horizon per interval and kernel.py:1789-1845 samples every endpoint/sat uplink-downlink and every ISL edge including retired/drained generations ('Idle physical links remain in the denominator'), so zero-service links do appear in the harness table; but the harness itself never enumerates the config topology, never checks that availability tiles [0, stop_time], and never cross-checks an availability window's rate against the link's service rate, so a kernel bug or corruption inflating availability would deflate utilization while every harness check stays green (utilization is then agreement on a number whose denominator is trusted, not measured).

required_revision: Add the physical service-window invariant to the independent implementation and the selftest: for outcome=ok, |(end-start)*rate_bps - served_bits| within the declared tolerance, reported per window; first sweep the R02 runs for legitimate exceptions and declare any in the tolerance contract. This closes the demonstrated hidden-time path P1 for tx windows; document explicitly that declared propagation delay_s remains trusted-by-construction (or add a geometry-level bound) so the residue-only semantics of chain 2 are stated rather than implied.

Define an explicit machine-checkable acceptance predicate in PROCEDURE.md sections 4-5 and emit a top-level verdict (e.g. all_ok) in the analyze and witness reports with a non-zero exit on any violation. The predicate must include positivity for both cd05 cells (gap_length_violation_total==0 AND closure_error_total==0 AND production mismatch totals==0 AND gap_count_total>=1 AND witness.admissible AND deferred_decision_rows>=1 AND per-packet reconciliation all-agree), so a mechanism-inert or zero-gap run is reported as unusable gate evidence instead of green.

Make undelivered decisions' unknown time reportable: per fate, sum and list uncovered time inside [emitted_at, stop_time] for undelivered packets (cd-sized chunks expected, final partial chunk truncated), or explicitly bound the chain-2 claim to the delivered-decision coverage fraction and state that fraction in every report.

Remove the --formal-trace-sha256/--diagnostic-trace-sha256 override flags, or keep them only to cross-check the receipts and fail loudly on contradiction; and emit tolerance_contract_s in the chain1 and witness reports so PROCEDURE.md:114 ('emitted in every report') becomes true.
